Class StagedSourceCompiler

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.compile.StagedSourceCompiler
All Implemented Interfaces:
SourceCompiler, Closeable, AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
GroovySourceCompiler, JavacSourceCompiler
@Internal public abstract class StagedSourceCompiler extends Object implements SourceCompiler
The incremental flow every embedded compiler shares: which sources to compile, hiding what they and the deleted sources produced before, staging the outputs, and replacing the previous outputs as one transaction on success. A compiler implements runCompilation(CompilationRequest, Set, Set, Path, Path, List) only.

An incremental request recompiles the changed sources and every source whose classes reference a changed or deleted class, as the ClassDependencyIndex of the current output tells. Class files and generated sources go to staging directories that replace the outputs only when the compilation succeeded, in one OutputTransaction: a failed edit leaves the running generation intact, deletions included, and a failed promotion is rolled back. Which top-level classes a source produces is learnt from the compiler and kept beside the class output (see SourceIndex), so a source declaring several top-level classes is handled whole.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

      Runs the compiler on the selected sources.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      toCompile - The sources to compile, absolute
      hiddenClasses - The top-level classes the compiler must not resolve from the class output: those of deleted sources and the previous outputs of the sources being compiled
      staging - Where class files and resources go
      generatedStaging - Where generated sources go
      diagnostics - Where to add the compiler's messages

    • compile

      public CompilationResult compile(CompilationRequest request)
      Description copied from interface: SourceCompiler
      Compiles the request.

      A failed compilation leaves the output directory as it was, so the running application keeps serving the previous generation. The result's diagnostics say what went wrong.

      Callers serialize compilations: a compiler may stage its output and back up what it replaces in fixed directories, so two calls of one compiler must not overlap. The launcher compiles on a single thread.

      Specified by:
      compile in interface SourceCompiler
      Parameters:
      request - What to compile
      Returns:
      The result
